candidate.title: An Innovative RAG Idea for Multi-hop Question Answering
candidate.description:
In this video, we introduce a new study called "Retrieve, Summarize, Plan(ReSP)", a new iterative RAG method to improve the accuracy and efficiency of multi-hop question answering.

The original address of this paper: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2407.13101v1

For more details, please visit: https://florianjune.substack.com/p/a-rag-solution-for-multi-hop-question or https://medium.com/@florian_algo/an-innovative-rag-idea-for-multi-hop-question-answering-e56a2ebe3ecd

My Medium account: medium.com/@florian_algo
